name: Assembly101
tagline: 513 h / 4,321 videos of 53 people assembling 101 toy vehicles from 12 synced views (8 static + 4 ego), with 1M fine + 100K coarse actions.

annotations.format: CSV + TXT (action labels); 3D hand poses in AssemblyPoses.zip
annotations.coverageNote: 1M fine-grained segments (1,380 classes = 24 verbs x 90 objects) + 100K coarse segments (202 classes) over all 4,321 videos; 18M 3D hand poses; mistake labels.

action_labels.note: 1,380 fine-grained (verb + object) and 202 coarse classes with frame ranges @30 fps

hand_pose.note: 18M 3D hand poses from the 4 egocentric monochrome cameras (AssemblyPoses)

scene_3d.note: 3D data is hand poses only; no scene scans
